wa_thriller_pillar.notes: PAIR (brief W): Thriller Pillar, Thriller Pillar Right Side and Thriller Pillar Left Side (wa_thriller_pillar_left_side, not mine) are three DIFFERENT lines on one pillar, each with its own MP page: the bolted face up the front (5.9+ sport), a chimney on the right that finishes in a wide crack (5.7 trad), and a chimney start behind the pillar on the left (5.7+ on MP; our row stores 5.7, not mine). Not duplicates. 2017 COLLAPSE: the pillar that fell on 2017-04-28 carried Price of Complacency and Stress Management, not this one. The MP forum thread says the falling pillar destroyed the boulder at Thriller Pillar's base; the route itself is not reported lost and the area reopened 2017-05-26. FA 'Ed Mosshart, Andy Fitz January, 1989' matches MP; FA never locks from MP alone. theCrag lists the route (one star) but sent the browser to its bot-check page on opening it; not used further.
